title: Experiments on the Effect of a Current of Electricity on the Magnetic Needle
version: Contemporary English translation, pp. 273–276, scholarly digital transcription by the Society for Danish Language and Literature.
lineage: Primary report in translation. Entire short report inspected; explanatory theory is retained as historical interpretation, not modern electrodynamics.
